item.title: Two people killed in single-car crash overnight in West Loop, according to Chicago police
item.description: Chicago police say officers responded to the crash in the 400 block of South Jefferson Street around 2:15 a.m. Sunday and found a white sedan on fire after it had crashed into a highway support column.

item.title: CTA bus crashes into apartment building on Near West Side after being hit by car Saturday night, police say
item.description: A CTA bus crashed into an apartment building on the Near West Side late Saturday night after it was hit by a car that had run a red light, according to the Chicago Police Department.

item.title: Indiana State Police: Gary man in custody on probable cause for OWI after crash on I-65 in Merrillville kills Waukegan man
item.description: A Gary, Indiana, man was held in custody on probable cause for OWI involving a fatality following a three-vehicle crash Saturday evening on I-65 in which one person was killed and another suffered life-threatening injuries.

item.title: 19-year-old Chicago man arrested in Phoenix, charged in November shooting at Jewel-Osco on South Side, police say
item.description: A 19-year-old Chicago man was arrested in Phoenix, Arizona, over the weekend and charged with attempted first-degree murder for allegedly shooting a man while robbing a Jewel-Osco on the South Side in November.

item.title: Monday Forecast: Chicagoland sees near-record warmth
item.description: Some areas could flirt with record highs as clouds thin and sunshine breaks through Monday afternoon. Temperatures are expected to surge well above normal, with a few spots possibly cracking 60 degrees.

item.title: Aurora community honors victims of 2019 shooting at Henry Pratt Company plant
item.description: An act of violence that unfolded in seconds at an Aurora manufacturing plant left a permanent mark on the community. On Sunday, grieving families honored their loved ones seven years after the tragic mass shooting.
